description: Defines classes and interfaces for a mockable QUIC test client used in testing QUIC protocol implementations, including MockableQuicClient and QuicTestClient with methods for sending requests, managing streams, and connection parameters.

classes.name: MockableQuicClient
classes.description: A mockable QUIC client class for testing, allowing control over connection IDs, network helper, and packet processing.

classes.name: QuicTestClient
classes.description: A test client for QUIC protocol, supporting sending requests, managing streams, and handling responses for testing purposes.

methods.name: SetUserAgentID
methods.description: Sets the user agent ID for the client.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Wraps data in a QUIC packet and sends it.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a simple GET request for a URI.

methods.name: SendRequestsAndWaitForResponses
methods.description: Sends multiple requests and waits for responses.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with headers and body.

methods.name: SendCustomSynchronousRequest
methods.description: Sends a request and waits synchronously for the response body.

methods.name: SendSynchronousRequest
methods.description: Sends a GET request and waits for the response body.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the server.

methods.name: MigrateSocket
methods.description: Migrates the socket to a new IP address.

methods.name: MigrateSocketWithSpecifiedPort
methods.description: Migrates the socket to a new IP address and port.

methods.name: GetOrCreateStream
methods.description: Gets or creates a new QUIC stream.

methods.name: GetOrCreateStreamAndSendRequest
methods.description: Gets or creates a stream, sends a request, and optionally resends if needed.
